assertions.quote: Differential diagnoses of DI include scabies incognito, Grover’s disease, dermatitis induced by mites, pets, caterpillars, moths, or fiberglass, substance-induced sensory disturbances, neurologic disease, systemic disease, and other psychiatric conditions.
